exposure: intrapartum antibiotic therapy (penicillin, vancomycin, clindamycin, cephalosporins)
cohort: GBS-positive pregnant patients, including penicillin-allergic individuals, from a single safety-net hospital between 2019 and 2022.
finding: Antibiotic effectiveness for GBS-positive pregnant patients varied by medication, with vancomycin appearing effective for penicillin-allergic patients and a significant difference in 30-day neonatal complications across groups.
